PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  ACTION SUMMARY
  SEPTEMBER 19, 2023, COMMISSION MEETING

Commission Members Present: Larry Giannone ( Chair), Bob Olander, Karol Curtis, Patrick
Jones, Orlando Pimental, Greg Tober, Ruth Luevand
Commission Members Absent:
City Representatives: City Manager Chris Constantin, Captain Walid Ashrafnia

 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS  COMMENTS/ RECOMMENDATIONS
  Kathi Began thanked everyone for serving on
  the Commission and discussed wanting to
  review Flock hits in her HOA.

 BUSINESS ITEMS  COMMENTS/ RECOMMENDATIONS
 BI.1 Swearing In of Commissioners and  Staff liaison Chris Constantin administered the
 Selection of Chair and Vice- Chair (City  oath of office to all members.
 Manager Chris Constantin)
  Motion by Patrick Jones and second by
  Orlando Pimental to nominate Larry Giannone
  as Commission Chair ( Passed 7-0).
  Motion by Larry Giannone and second by
  Karol Curtis to nominate Bob Olander as
  Commission Vice- Chair ( Passed 7-0).
 BI.2 Orientation to Commission  Liaison Constantin conducted the verbal
 Responsibility, Board and Commission  orientation training.
 Handbook, and General City Familiarization
 City Manager Chris Constantin)
 BI.3 Approval of Minutes for July 18, 2023  Motion by Patrick Jones and seconded by
 City Manager Chris Constantin)  Karol Curtis to approve the minutes of July 18,
  2023. ( Passed 7-0).

 New Business Items  COMMENTS/ RECOMMENDATIONS
 September 19, 2023 Public Safety Commission Minutes  Page 2

 NB1 Discussion of Part 1 Crimes for January 1  Captain Ashrafnia presented Part 1 Crime
 through June 31st, 2022 and 2023. ( Captain  statistics for the period of January 1 through
 Walid Ashrafnia)  July 31st 2023 compared to 2022.

 REPORTS  COMMENTS/ RECOMMENDATIONS
 R1 Commissioner Reports  Patrick Jones – Desires to have a future item
  related to the LASD staffing vehicles as two-
  person cars.

  Ruth Luevand – Indicated that in conversations
  with parents, parents do not feel safe walking
  to school. Luevand also believes that the City
  should have better marked bike lands to
  encourage more use by children. Luevand also
  desires the City to encourage schools to allow
  storage of electric bikes on campus.

  Orlando Pimental – Raised concerns about the
  Highway 57 northbound exit onto Arrow and
  Bonita. Changes to the lanes have resulted in a
  backup on the freeway.

  Karol Curtis – Concerned about drivers not
  stopping at stop signs. Curtis emphasized
  having seen multiple instances of this occurring
  outside Curtis’ s downtown office.

  Greg Tober – Indicated that it may be
  beneficial to put out crime statistics out on
  social media in similar fashion as we have
  discussed at the Commission.

  Bob Olander – Thanks staff and the Sheriff’ s
  Office for the deployment of Flock cameras
  that are on both public and non-public
  locations. There is a Wildlife and Hiking Safet
  meeting discussing several topics and the
  meeting starts at 5:30pm on September 21,
  2023.
 R2 Station Captain’ s Report ( Captain
 Ashrafnia)  Captain Ashrafnia updated the commission on
  the new bail schedules, Coffee with a Cop,
  Business Watch meeting. The deputies had a
  good arrest related to a murder in Brea. Our
  San Dimas deputies found the suspect at a
 September 19, 2023 Public Safety Commission Minutes  Page 3

  Starbucks on Arrow Highway in Covina. The
  San Dimas Station held a crime prevention
  event for seniors related to cyber crimes and
  fraud in partnership with the City.
 R3 City Staff Liaison Report ( City Manager
 Chris Constantin)  City has been deploying CPR, AED and
  Naloxone training. City staff utilized CPR
  recently at the senior center to as senior. This
  training fits with the direction of our
  Community Emergency Response Team where
  we are trying to enhance the capabilities we
  have in our community to respond during
  emergencies. City has been developing
  emergency operations plans and we will be
  bringing them to the Commission for review.

The meeting adjourned at 6:54 PM.
